description: Pixar's OpenUSD (Universal Scene Description) for .NET 10 — bundles the managed USD.NET assembly (from Unity's com.unity.usd.core), per-RID native USD runtime libraries, and the Pixar plugin tree. The .NET SDK auto-deploys native assets to the consumer's output directory via the standard runtimes/<rid>/native/ convention. Native binaries are included for win-x64, linux-x64, osx-x64, and osx-arm64.
title: Universal Scene Description for .NET
